metadata.description: Machine-readable falsification test registry. Each entry defines a falsifiable assumption, the strategy for testing it, and mappings to domains, OI-IDs, and case studies. Tests are assigned F-IDs and can be referenced by test files via the @falsification_id tag.
metadata.tagging_convention: Add a comment '# @falsification_id: F-XXX-NNN' at the top of any test that implements or covers a falsification test listed here.

falsification_tests.title: sha256 is byte-identical across platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: hashlib.sha256 of a fixed byte string returns the same hex digest on every OS/Python version.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Different hex digest produced on any CI runner.
falsification_tests.strategy: Hash a fixed seed; compare against a canonical expected value.

falsification_tests.title: int64 arithmetic matches known vectors
falsification_tests.assumption: Python int64 two's-complement arithmetic and struct.unpack produce identical values on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any computed value ≠ expected vector.
falsification_tests.strategy: Pre-compute known (seed, index, expected_int64) triples; assert equality.

falsification_tests.title: pathlib normalises path separators
falsification_tests.assumption: pathlib.Path correctly resolves relative paths and normalises separators on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Wrong path-parts count or values.
falsification_tests.strategy: Construct a Path with forward slashes; assert parts match expected tuple.

falsification_tests.title: stdout is UTF-8
falsification_tests.assumption: stdout/stderr encoding is UTF-8 (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 is honoured).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Encoding name is not 'utf-8' or 'utf_8'.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inspect sys.stdout.encoding; assert UTF-8.

falsification_tests.title: struct.pack is little-endian
falsification_tests.assumption: struct.pack('<q', value) encodes int64 in little-endian byte order regardless of host endianness.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any byte sequence ≠ expected.
falsification_tests.strategy: Pack known values; compare against expected byte strings.

falsification_tests.title: Shader compilation is deterministic across runs
falsification_tests.assumption: Compiling the same GLSL/HLSL/SPIR-V source twice produces byte-identical output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Binary hash differs between two compilation invocations.
falsification_tests.strategy: Compile a canonical test shader twice in the same process; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2). Also compare across backends (Vulkan/Metal/D3D via cross-compilation).
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Use glslang or spirv-cross in subprocess; hash stdout bytes. Requires GPU or offline compiler tool.

falsification_tests.title: Lock-free atomics are sequentially consistent on target hardware
falsification_tests.assumption: Atomic operations provide sequentially-consistent ordering on all CI and production hardware targets.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A data-race or stale read is observed under a weak-memory model emulator.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run concurrent increment/read test under TSAN (ThreadSanitizer) and/or C11 weak-ordering emulator; assert zero races.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Python: use threading + events; C extension: compile with -fsanitize=thread.

falsification_tests.title: External API is reachable within SLO timeout
falsification_tests.assumption: The external weather/data API responds within the defined SLO timeout under normal network conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: API call times out or returns a non-2xx status within the SLO window.
falsification_tests.strategy: Probe the API endpoint with a small test payload; assert response within timeout. Skipped in offline/air-gapped CI.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Use requests with timeout parameter. Mark as @pytest.mark.network and skip unless NETWORK_TESTS=1 env var is set.

falsification_tests.title: Secret-dependent polynomial arithmetic is constant-time
falsification_tests.assumption: The implementation of PQC polynomial arithmetic does not leak timing information correlated with secret key bits.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: dudect or ctgrind reports a statistically significant timing leak (p < 0.001).
falsification_tests.strategy: Run dudect over 1M samples of the target function with random secrets; assert Welch's t < 5.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Requires ctgrind or Python ctypes wrapper around dudect. Computationally expensive; run on dedicated CI job.

falsification_tests.title: Noise PSK zero-key is rejected
falsification_tests.assumption: The library enforces PSK ≠ 0^32 at the API boundary.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Library accepts a 32-byte all-zero PSK without raising an error.
falsification_tests.strategy: Call the PSK-setting API with bytes(32); assert a ValueError or ProtocolError is raised.

falsification_tests.title: Compiled binary contains stack canaries
falsification_tests.assumption: All safety-critical C binaries are compiled with stack-protector flags (-fstack-protector-strong).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: objdump/readelf shows no __stack_chk_fail import in the binary.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run readelf -s on the target binary; assert __stack_chk_fail is present.

falsification_tests.title: XSS payload is neutralized before HTML output
falsification_tests.assumption: All user-supplied Markdown/HTML passes through a context-aware sanitizer before being rendered.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A canonical XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>) appears unescaped in rendered output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Submit the canonical payload through the rendering pipeline; assert the output contains no literal <script> tag.

falsification_tests.title: ASI loader slot is exclusive (no dual-loader conflict)
falsification_tests.assumption: Only one ASI loader DLL can occupy the loader interception point in a game process.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two ASI loaders are present in the game directory simultaneously without conflict detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Scan game directory for known ASI loader filenames (dinput8.dll, dsound.dll, etc.); assert at most one is present.

falsification_tests.title: Dosimetry calculation matches reference implementation within tolerance
falsification_tests.assumption: The software dosimetry calculation agrees with the IEC 62304 reference algorithm within ±0.1%.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Computed dose deviates from reference by more than 0.1%.
falsification_tests.strategy: Feed a canonical patient-phantom dataset through both implementations; assert relative error < 0.001.

falsification_tests.title: PLC cycle-time is within real-time bound
falsification_tests.assumption: The PLC control loop completes each cycle within the specified real-time deadline.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any cycle exceeds the deadline budget.
falsification_tests.strategy: Instrument the control loop with high-resolution timers; assert max(cycle_times) ≤ deadline_ms.

falsification_tests.title: Worker safety alert delivered within required latency
falsification_tests.assumption: Worker safety alerts are delivered within the required response time.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alert delivery latency exceeds the required bound.
falsification_tests.strategy: Measure end-to-end alert delivery time under simulated load; assert max latency ≤ bound.

falsification_tests.title: Document processing pipeline is idempotent
falsification_tests.assumption: Document processing pipelines are idempotent.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical input produce different output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run the pipeline twice with identical input; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: HFT order-book state is deterministic
falsification_tests.assumption: HFT order-book state is deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Replay test produces different fills.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay a recorded market-event sequence twice; assert identical fill records.

falsification_tests.title: Dispatch system handles network partition without data loss
falsification_tests.assumption: Dispatch systems handle network partitions without data loss.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A message is lost or duplicated during simulated partition.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate network partition; assert all messages are delivered exactly once after partition heals.

falsification_tests.title: Infrastructure control software meets SIL requirements
falsification_tests.assumption: All control-system software meets IEC 61508 SIL requirements.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Formal SIL assessment is absent or fails.
falsification_tests.strategy: Assert presence of a signed SIL certificate in the ontology evidence store.

falsification_tests.title: ETL pipeline is idempotent
falsification_tests.assumption: ETL pipelines are idempotent: re-running produces the same output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Row count or aggregate differs between two runs.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run ETL twice; assert row counts and checksums are identical.

falsification_tests.title: Game save data is forward-compatible across versions
falsification_tests.assumption: Saved game data is forward-compatible with new versions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Save file from version N fails to load in version N+1.
falsification_tests.strategy: Load a canonical save file from version N in version N+1; assert no error and expected state.

falsification_tests.title: Generative output is reproducible from fixed seed
falsification_tests.assumption: Given a fixed seed, generative output is reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical seed produce different sha256 hashes.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run generator twice with fixed seed; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: Compression round-trip is lossless
falsification_tests.assumption: Compression/decompression is lossless and reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: sha256(decompress(compress(data))) ≠ sha256(data).
falsification_tests.strategy: Compress and decompress a canonical dataset; assert sha256 equality.
